newsitem.title: USA: Yellen confirmed as Clinton's top economist.
newsitem.headline: Yellen confirmed as Clinton's top economist.

text.p: The Senate Thursday confirmed without debate Janet Yellen as chairman of the White House's Council of Economic Advisers.

A Federal Reserve governor for 2 1/2 years, Yellen, 50, was a consistent supporter of Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan -- first in his efforts to head off inflation by raising interest rates, then to keep the economy purring by cutting them. She is
a former professor at the University of California at Berkeley.
President Clionton, in nominating her for the top econmomic post, had called her an "esteemed writer and thinker who will serve our country well."
